status: PROPOSAL - frozen before its single validation observation; replaces nothing until the owner accepts it; v1 results stay as recorded

v1.wording: 6. Independent cross-check of the pose source: the /scan ranges to the world walls agree with the welded pose (0, 0, 0.125 m, yaw 0) to within the M0 +-8 mm. A disagreement means pose/info does not describe the simulated body, and nothing else in this list can be trusted.
v1.measurement_as_written: individual ranges (M0 checked individual wall and pillar distances at expected bearings)

objective.statement: detect a pose/info body pose that does not describe the simulated body, at the size the run must catch
objective.source: config/m61a_fixed_base.yaml attachment.translation_tolerance_m / rotation_tolerance_rad (G8): the smallest body displacement the run itself must detect
objective.not_claimed: the 1 mm / 0.0033 rad acceptance margins of criterion 2 (the sensor cannot resolve them; they remain checks of the pose source against itself)

sensor_model.noise_source: gpu_lidar <noise> stddev 0.01 (SDF); measured per-beam sd 9.85-9.99 mm (runs 1-3)
sensor_model.systematic_per_beam: rendering error, about 5 mm RMS, incidence-dependent (0-15 deg 2.4 mm RMS, 15-30 deg 5.4, 30-40 deg 8.7, 40-46 deg mean -5.6 mm), identical across launches (run-to-run difference RMS 2.16 mm = noise-only 2.24 mm; correlation 0.92), uncorrelated between neighbouring beams (lag 1-8 |r| <= 0.18)
sensor_model.consequence_for_v1: no planar pose brings every 40-scan mean within +-8 mm (minimax 16.7-17.1 mm in runs 1-3) and single-scan ranges are within +-8 mm only 52-53 % of the time: v1 measures this sensor error, not the pose
sensor_model.characterization_data: observation_7f4c30f run_01..03 (sensor characterization only; NOT judged under v2)

metric.definition: body (base_link) planar pose (x, y, yaw) fitted to the 40-scan per-beam means of the frozen beam set against the world collision geometry, minus the body pose that pose/info reports in the same capture window (T_world_model * T_model_dummy * T_dummy_body, T_dummy_body = identity per the URDF dummy_joint); |dxy| is the Euclidean planar distance
metric.why_this_measurement: the objective concerns the pose; a fit over ~340 beams averages the per-beam rendering error that individual ranges cannot escape

uncertainty.sigma_robust: 1.4826 * MAD of the final per-beam residuals times sqrt(diag(inv(J^T J))) (per-beam errors are independent: lag correlations <= 0.18)
uncertainty.sigma_jackknife: leave-one-surface-out (7 surfaces) jackknife of the fit: captures surface-level systematic error

decision_targets.derivation: xy: |dxy| under no discrepancy is Rayleigh(sigma): tau >= sigma*sqrt(-2 ln alpha) = 3.035 sigma; at a discrepancy delta, P(|dxy| <= tau) <= Phi((tau - delta)/sigma) <= beta: tau <= delta - 1.645 sigma; feasible iff sigma <= delta / 4.680. yaw: two-sided normal: tau >= 2.576 sigma; tau <= delta - 1.645 sigma; feasible iff sigma <= delta / 4.221. tau = delta - 1.645 sigma_max.
decision_targets.sensitivity_note: a stricter pair (0.3 % / 2.3 %) would need sigma_xy <= 0.55 mm; the jackknife reached 0.585 mm in one characterization run. The conventional pair (1 % / 5 %) is used and this is recorded, not hidden.

prerequisites.rule: any prerequisite not met -> INCONCLUSIVE (never PASS)

beam_exclusions.rule: the closeout masks (closeout/frozen_harness.json), frozen as explicit lists; the fit uses this fixed set (no re-selection); a beam with no finite mean is dropped and counted

counterfactual_rule: the measured per-beam error pattern of the same capture is re-applied to the body displaced by each offset; the frozen fit must recover the offset within 3 sigma_used per component, and every offset at or above delta must FAIL
validation: ONE fresh no-motion fixed-base observation (run_04) with the frozen harness, after this file is committed and pushed
scope: x, y, yaw only: a horizontal scan of vertical walls cannot observe z, roll or pitch (section 8.2 U-L2)
